title: Sidebar navigation
description: A side menu linking to pages of an app. Icons react to hover and the keyboard, and the current page is highlighted.
iconsNote: The icons in this sidebar use the default Hover state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. Stick with the default animation, as In, Morph and Loop states don’t work well here.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: One destination
fragments.note: Hovering anywhere on a row plays its icon, and the current page is tinted.

fragments.title: Move aria-current on click
fragments.note: Added to one link, removed from the rest. No icon in sight.

fragments.title: Hovered and current rows
fragments.note: The icon changes colour with its row.

fragments.title: The sidebar's height
fragments.note: The sidebar keeps the height it was designed at whenever the screen allows.
